units.source_text: 辞别女御之后，装作顺便的样子，走到花散里所居的西厅前，向室内张望一下。

en.t: After taking leave of the lady nyogo, he pretended to be passing by casually and went to the west wing where Hanachirusato lived, then looked inside the room for a moment.

units.source_text: 花散里久不见源氏公子，相见之后，加之他的美貌盖世无双，便把过去的怨恨尽行忘却。

en.t: Hanachirusato had not seen Prince Genji for a long time, and when they met again, his peerless beauty made her forget all her old resentment.

units.source_text: 源氏公子照例情深意密地和她谈此说彼，想来不是口是心非的话吧。

en.t: As usual, Prince Genji spoke with her tenderly and intimately about many things, and surely these were not words that contradicted his true feelings.

units.source_text: 凡是源氏公子所交往的女子，不仅花散里一人，都不是寻常之人，都有独得的优点。

en.t: All the women with whom Prince Genji associated, not only Hanachirusato, were far from ordinary people, and each possessed her own special virtues.

units.source_text: 因此相见之下，两情融洽，男女双方互相怜爱不尽。

en.t: For that reason, when they met, their feelings blended harmoniously, and the man and woman cherished each other without end.

units.source_text: 固然也有为了公子久疏问候而伤心变节的女子，但公子认为此亦人世之常情。

en.t: Of course, there were also women who, hurt because the prince had long neglected to visit or write, changed their hearts, but the prince considered this too a natural human feeling.

units.source_text: 刚才中川途中篱内的那个女子，便是因此而变节的一例。

en.t: The woman inside the fence on the way to Nakagawa just now was one example of someone who had changed her heart for that reason.
